title: The Dying Blade
author: jgesq
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/3718by0ypjhg1.png?width=1536&format=png&auto=webp&s=e122c8c005dc7be556cff958dbfe70df71cfc5d0

I continue to use CLaude AI to develop historical and singular Solo RPG games dedicated to unique moments in time. **The Dying Blade** is a solo journaling RPG set during Japan's Meiji Restoration (1876–1882), when the government banned the sword and systematically dismantled the samurai schools. You play a ronin caught between a dying world and a future that has no place for you.

This is not a power fantasy. You are genuinely outmatched. A swordsman against riflemen is not an even fight, and the dice know it. The game uses asymmetric two-phase combat that reflects this reality — you must close distance before you can strike, and every step forward is dangerous.
